text: I can choose a chunking strategy, size and overlap for a corpus and compute the resulting chunk count and index size.
I can explain why access control belongs in the retrieval filter and never in the prompt.
I can combine BM25 and vector results with reciprocal rank fusion and compute the fused scores by hand.
I can assemble a prompt within a token budget with deduplicated, labelled chunks and verify the model's citations.
I can trace a wrong answer to parsing, chunking, retrieval, ranking or generation using logged chunk ids and retrieval hit rate.
I can design re-indexing that propagates deletes, re-embeds only changed chunks and swaps a new index in behind an alias.
